sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Unique-values dropdown: renamed the 'Roles' section (SYN_SECTION_META's `roles` entry, exact-combined-role-string match) to 'Entity info - Role (combined)' — it was the only label in the table breaking the "Topic - Capitalized subtopic" naming convention, which made it read as an unexplained duplicate of the sibling 'Entity info - Role' (decomposed, OR-matching) section next to it on any Artist column carrying role credits (e.g. a place's /events page). No behavior change — both sections keep their distinct filter semantics.

Unique-values dropdown: renamed 'Event info - Event date'/'Event info - Event cancelled' (SYN_SECTION_META's `eventInfo`/`eventCancelled` entries, e.g. a user's own /ratings/event/ page's Event column) to 'Event info - Date'/'Event info - Cancelled' — dropped the redundant repeated "Event" word after the dash, since the section's own topic prefix already says "Event info". Left the unrelated 'Entity info - Event name'/'Entity info - Event cancelled' entries (a different topic family, sibling of Entity info - Artist name/Label name/etc.) untouched — they already follow the entity_* family's own established convention of repeating the entity-type word.
